a4e52f3e2473b5e18b05be0dcde2019164f0c48e.summary: Quorum Cyber describes SharpRhino, a C# remote access trojan (RAT) it found during a ransomware incident it investigated. The malware is delivered through typosquatting that impersonates the Angry IP Scanner tool, establishes persistence on execution, and gives the attacker remote access. Quorum Cyber attributes the incident to Hunters International, a ransomware-as-a-service group, and says the malware variant is linked to the ThunderShell malware family.

a4f74c55f5359b7588ac88acc87d71e0c9f81b42.summary: Report on a June 2023 ransomware attack on Bangladesh Krishi Bank, attributed to the AlphV (BlackCat) group. The attackers claim 12 days inside the network, over 170Gb of data taken, encrypted servers, and a demand to negotiate under threat of publication. They emailed the bank on June 23 and July 6 and set a 72-hour deadline from July 8. Bank officials told local media there was no hacking, or that the servers were only down. The report contrasts these statements with the attackers' claims and says the bank had not replied to its questions.

a4c0a0e20dde65fdc9e7919ae57e6f6f184ba192.summary: BleepingComputer reported in March 2021 that Taiwanese electronics maker Acer was hit by a REvil ransomware attack with a $50 million demand, described as the largest known ransom to date. The report cites a REvil data leak site post with leaked images and a ransom sample it says matches the Acer attack. Acer did not confirm a REvil attack and said it was investigating. A researcher's claim that a REvil affiliate targeted an Acer Exchange server is presented only as possible. The report also cites an earlier $30 million REvil demand against Dairy Farm.
